status: PROVISIONAL DEMO ASSUMPTIONS — NOT FIELD CALIBRATED
source_note: Copied from the supplied ShiftShield Plan v7 starting assumptions. They are not claimed as independently validated constants. Site-specific WBGT estimates are not sensor readings.

formula.relative_humidity_site: recompute at the same water-vapor pressure

surface_factor.range_note: The source plan gives grass about 0.05 and light concrete about 0.20–0.25; other rows use the upper stated value as an explicitly assumed conservative demo default.

land_use_delta_c.range_note: Plan v7 assumption about 0 to +2°C; not a local measured correction.

wind_factor.range_note: Plan v7 assumption about 1.0 open to 0.4 sheltered; unknown defaults to the lower-wind case.

uncertainty_margin_c.range_note: Plan v7 starting value near 1°C; configurable and disclosed. It is not an official NIOSH margin.
